Radio Competitions

Radio stations are rapidly becoming another good source of big prizes. Heart for example have recently concluded their latest Make Me A Millionaire promotion whilst the likes of Talk Radio, Virgin, Smooth and Radio X regularly run giveaways. Be warned though because competitions are used by radio stations to generate ad revenue and many of the big competitions will require you to either phone-in or send a text message at a cost. Some contests will also require you to go on-air. If you can overcome your fear of radio comping then it's well worth getting involved with. Some of these comps may require early entry!

Popular: Heart, Bauer Radio, Virgin Radio, Hits Radio

Below are just a handful of the latest prize draws and competitions that are currently listed on Loquax. Please register/login to get access to more listings, use direct links to the prize draws and also use our free tracking facility. You will also be able access our forums and be part of the Loquax Community.
